_comment: Single source for /resume AND the three PDFs in public/. Edit here, then run scripts/build_resume_pdfs.py. **bold** marks highlights, [text](url) marks links. onepage:true bullets are the ones kept on the 1-page PDF. Wording follows the LinkedIn profile, which is the source of truth (Chris, 2026-10-06).
name: Chris De La Garza
title: Staff Solutions Engineer
summary: Infrastructure Engineer turned Solutions Engineer with a decade of building, breaking, and securing systems across bare metal, cloud, and Kubernetes. Known for building demo and enablement systems that outlast the engagement. Today I'm a Staff Solutions Engineer on Teleport's enterprise team and the SE org's Terraform SME.
